isolated_real_backend.implementation: Native Go control service, SQLite and built SPA; no mocked responses
interactions: Mobile navigation selection, Escape and focus restoration
Upload source selection and local-program form
Settings section navigation retains unsaved draft; explicit authoritative reload
exact_bundle_cases: Owned native component start, restart, stop and missing-executable error
Repeated action produces a single mutation
Actual configuration revision conflict preserves draft; reload and save persist
Empty current sessions and history; no fabricated rows
isolated_real_backend.boundary: Unconfigured media components intentionally return actual unavailable responses. This environment does not establish media acceptance.

installed_management.transport: HTTPS with existing trusted deployment CA; no TLS bypass
installed_management.screenshots: Captured for all route/viewport checks and configuration sections; settings and application-detail screenshots visually reviewed. Private artifacts remain outside the product and public repository.
installed_management.boundary: Read-only page navigation and local UI interaction; no application launch, production configuration write, renderer or gateway replacement.

deployment.rollback: The first directory replacement was rejected by Windows and restored the previous service. Subsequent maintenance passed a staged-directory move preflight, installed the complete reviewed bundle and verified component readiness.
deployment.boundary: Component maintenance, not a new unified installer or public release. Full host reboot and media acceptance at the new LAN address remain outside this layout acceptance.
